description: This file defines a Password controller class for handling password-related actions such as displaying the password change form and saving the new password within an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Controller class managing user password change functionalities including displaying the form and processing password updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the password change form, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading common layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for changing password, validates input, updates password in the database, and returns JSON response with success or error messages.
